notes.title: Updated version of Elea is now available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Last month we announced that Elea would get an updated version on a new AppID. After some delay we are happy to share with you that the updated version is now available!

Some extra information regarding this release:

 For everyone that already owns Elea; you'll get new version for free and will soon be added to your library. This old version will remain available for the people who already own old version.
 The old store page for this version will be hidden and only the new version will be available for purchase. 


You can find the new Store Page for Elea right here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122150/ELEA/

Thanks for your support and we hope you'll enjoy Elea!

- Danny

notes.title: Big updates coming to Elea + PS4 release
notes.notes:
Hi all!

It's been a while since we've posted here, but I come bearing good news! The guys at Kyodai haven't been sitting still, because there's some huge updates coming to Elea. The game will be drastically improved both graphically and gameplay wise. There's new shading features, shorter loading times and optimization for new video cards but also completely new scenes, new gameplay mechanics and over 200 bug fixes and additions.

Later this month we'll share the specifics with you about how this'll work and what exactly is coming to the game. In the meantime, we just announced that Elea is coming to PS4 as well! You can check out the full story here: https://soedesco.com/elea-comes-to-ps4-on-25-july/

Hope to see you next time, when we'll have all the specifics of the update for you.

See ya!

-Marten

notes.title: First patch since launch! v1.1 patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It's Marten here with some fresh patch notes! v1.1 is live now and it's the first update since launch! Here's what we've done:

New save checkpoint at the end of the episode - when you die in the chasing scene, you will return directly to the beginning of the said chasing scene.
Opportunity to tone down or switch off post processing effects like CA (chromatic aberration) and motion blur
UI 4K optimizations for Ultra HD users
Faster and longer sprinting - Elea's stamina is greater in the 1.1 build
Optimized cursors animations - the animations are faster and less glitchy 
Slower camera speed control by default for better interactions with the world
Added new scenes
Optimized streaming, lighting and localization improvements 
30+ smaller bug fixes

So, what do you think? Is there anything else you'd like to see in there? Let me know! For now, have a great day ;)

-Marten

notes.title: Patch v0.9 is now live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It's Marten here! We just published update v0.9 and we added a whole new story intro to the game! Jump in and check it out. Of course there's other things in this patch as well, read the full list here:

Added completely new story overview at the beginning of the game
Optimization of the level loading system
Optimization of the save & load system
Update of some meshes and textures
New game intro
Audio improvements
Localization fixes and updates
Scripting updates & changes (for example, the player can skip the logos at the beginning of the game, enable the subtitles during the gameplay)
Small bug-fixes
Some visual updates (for example, there is a time & location text at the beginning of each chapter, loading icon when bigger sub-level is loading during gameplay)
Improved puzzle hints in the server core

What do you think? Let us know!

Have a nice weekend!

-Marten

notes.title: Another patch is coming up!
notes.notes:
Hey all! 

We’ve been a bit quiet lately, because we’ve been working hard on preparing the Xbox One version of Elea.

But now we have an update to share: another patch is coming up! Patch 0.9 will release on the 10th of August. 

 
For this patch, we focused on making the narrative more understandable by adding context to the story at the start of the game, and adding times and locations to different scenes.

Besides that, we worked on polishing the audio, visuals, texts, systems and more.

 Keep an eye on us for more news, because we’ll soon have a release date to share with you!

Thanks, 
Hans

notes.title: Patch v0.8 is live now! Sound updates + Memory Optimization
notes.notes:
Hey all!

Today there's another update, it's time for v0.8!

Huge audio update - Elea now features full 5.1 surround support (you need a 5.1 surround system to experience this) and better mastering for the sound mix (stereo and 5.1)
Audio is streamed instead of cached in the memory all the time. This optimizes memory
Fixed a bug where saves made at the beginning of the Broken Mindscape level would dissapear
Fixed the bug where the Oculus & Vive app would open when starting the game
Now you can run/sprint in every Recovery chapter floors (there's an exception when there's a controlled situation like conversations/cutscenes) 
You can run longer compared to v0.7. Your sprint will recharge once you move slower, so in practice, you can run almost all the time 
Some visual changes/updates (for example, the final scene has a new visual facelift)
Some scripting updates/changes
Smaller input icons 
Localization fixes and updates
Over 20 small bug-fixes

If you have anything to report or any questions, let me know in the comments below or start a new discussion in the Community Hub!

Thanks all!

-Marten

notes.title: Patch v0.7 is live! Biggest patch since Early Access launch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today is the day, patch v0.7 is live! The biggest patch since the Early Access launch. Now, onto the good stuff! You can find the full patch notes right here:

Fixed the bug when Oculus app is opening when starting the game
Unlocked FPS option now supports 120 fps
New auto-save checkpoints are implemented in the Recovery chapter
Additional and improved objective hints
Completely new how to play help screen is available in the settings menu and at the start of the game
Various performance updates in regards to the streaming system in the game
New voice over for some characters
Better screen space reflections (SSR) when effects in the settings menu are on ULTRA. The higher version of SSR can decrease your performances with up to 10FPS. Effects settings on HIGH in the new 0.7 build are comparable in quality to Ultra in the older builds. 
New voice lines for Elea - some of them can potentially help with the game progression
Fixed the bug in which Elea can stuck in the first room in the house chapter
Faster animations for the interaction icons in the game 
Improved and completely new scenes in the game
Updated localization
Fixed the bug when after you finish the Mars level, two Alice's at the same time appeared
Opportunity for infinite running in Mars chapter
Increased sprint duration before having to recover in the Recovery chapter
New and updated sound fx
Over 100 small bug-fixes and updates
Fixed the bug for zooming with the mouse right button in the House chapter 

I'd love to hear what you think of the new stuff we added! If there's anything else you'd like to let us know, please do! Write a comment down below or start a new discussion in the Community Hub.

For now, I wish all of you a great weekend!

Bye!

-Marten

notes.title: Big patch incoming!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

Just a quick update to let you know we've been working on a huge update for the past month! I'm sorry we broke the cycle of regular updates for a while, but we've been focussing on bigger stuff now.

We migrated Elea from Unreal Engine 4.18 to 4.19, made preperations for the launch on Xbox One and implemented tons of fixes and new features! 

Here's a small sneak peak on some things that are going to be in the next patch:

Over 100 small bug-fixes and updates
Unlocked FPS option now supports 120 fps
New auto-save checkpoint is implemented
Improved objective hints
Completely new how to play help screen is available in the settings menu

Full patch notes are coming when the update drops!

Please keep in mind, Kyodai is a small, but dedicated and motivated team and all your feedback is greatly appreciated! Thanks so much everyone for helping out and see you soon!

-Marten

notes.title: Patch notes V0.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Here we are again, and we're back with a very big update! Check out what's new:

33% faster-moving speed of the main character Elea is implemented in the "A life full of promises" chapter. The movement speed is only increased when not in conversation
A new hint system is introduced, giving the player more detailed objective information by pressing 'i' or left on the D-pad
The player can run in some parts of Recovery chapter (Shift/Left Bumper)
Most important objects in the game are highlighted
Over a 50 small fixes and improvements, including (but not limited to) small gameplay changes and tweaks in some situations, some grammar mistakes, and streaming optimizations.

Don't have Elea yet? You can win it for free here: https://twitter.com/SOEDESCO/status/990943947026518016

If you've got any questions, please let me know! Also, if you've got any bugs to report or suggestions to make, please head over to this thread! https://steamcommunity.com/app/812020/discussions/0/3288067088118307090/
